analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Affiliates
analysis.quote: Dropbox shares infrastructure, systems, and technology with other Dropbox Companies to provide, improve, protect, and promote Dropbox Company Services.

analysis.headline: Shares Your Data with Partners
analysis.quote: Dropbox uses certain trusted third parties (for example, providers of customer support and IT services) for the business purposes of helping us provide, improve, protect, and promote our Services.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Content Viewing
analysis.quote: When you view content included in portions of our Services that provide analytics to content owners, we collect information including your identifying and device information, such as email addresses, IP addresses, and device identifiers of devices you use to view the content. We also collect information on how you interact with the viewed content, such as the date and time you view the content, the number of times and length of time you view the content, and which portions of the content you view.

analysis.headline: Employer Controls Your Account
analysis.quote: If you are a user of a Dropbox Team, your administrator may have the ability to access and control your Dropbox Team account.

analysis.headline: Collects Your Location Data
analysis.quote: Your devices (depending on their settings) may also transmit location information to the Services.

analysis.headline: Third-Party Apps Use Your Data
analysis.quote: Please remember that third parties’ use of your information will be governed by their own privacy policies and terms of service.

analysis.headline: Retains Your Data Post-Deletion
analysis.quote: there might be some latency in deleting this information from our servers and back-up storage; and (2) we may retain this information if necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, or enforce our agreements.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Globally
analysis.quote: To provide you with the Services, we may store, process, and transmit data in the United States and locations around the world—including those outside your country.

analysis.headline: AI Used for Abuse Detection
analysis.quote: We deploy automated technologies to detect abusive behavior and content that may harm our Services, you, or other users.
